title: Egyptian authorities board up the paw and drill misleading holes

tellings.quote: down there and the Egyptian authorities came through and they boarded up the front of the Paw with boards literal boards and blocked it off

plain: In the 1990s, Egyptian authorities are said to have covered the front of one of the Great Sphinx's paws at Giza with "literal boards" and blocked it off, and to have drilled holes that would mislead anyone looking. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells this, linking it to radar scans said to show hollow spaces under the Sphinx. If true, it would mean officials hid whatever lies beneath the monument.
